payload.goal: Add expense categories to the splitter. Extend the Expense type with an optional category field that must be one of exactly "food", "transport", "lodging", "entertainment" or "other", rejecting any other value, add computeCategoryTotals to the domain, expose listCategoryTotals from the API layer, render a category breakdown in the web surface, and cover the new behaviour with tests. Preserve the existing balance behaviour and keep the current tests green.

computeCategoryTotals returns category totals without changing existing balance calculations.

children.title: Expose category totals from API
children.objective: Expose listCategoryTotals through the API layer using the domain category-total behavior.
expectedOutcomes: API layer exports or otherwise exposes listCategoryTotals consistently with existing expense API patterns.
listCategoryTotals delegates to domain category total computation instead of duplicating aggregation rules.
API tests verify exposed category totals and preserve existing list or balance behavior.

children.title: Render category breakdown

Existing balance presentation remains present and unchanged in meaning.
Tests verify the category breakdown output and existing balance behavior.
